products.descriptionHtml:
Whether you're a lifelong constituent or a new fan of his advocacy, these James Talarico Unofficial Campaign Magnets are the perfect way to show your support. Known for his "common sense" approach and dedication to Texas public schools, Representative Talarico has become a standout voice in our community; and now you can bring that energy to your home or workspace.

Designed right here in the Manor/Austin area, these magnets are crafted for supporters who want to display their local pride with high-quality, durable gear.

Magnets with a Mission

We believe in the message. That’s why Magnet Moments Co. is proud to announce that $2 from every magnet sold will be donated directly to the James Talarico Campaign. Your purchase doesn't just show your support, it actively contributes to the movement.

Product Highlights:

  • Locally Inspired: Designed by Magnet Moments Co. for our Texas neighbors.

  • High-Quality Finish: Features a crisp, vibrant design that won’t fade, ensuring the message stays front and center.

  • Strong Magnetic Hold: Perfect for holding up schedules, photos, or your "To-Do" list without sliding.

  • The Ideal Size: Available in our signature 2x2 or 2x3 sizes, making them a versatile addition to any magnetic surface.

Why You’ll Love It:

Whether you're gearing up for the next town hall or just want to spark a conversation in the breakroom, these magnets are a subtle yet bold way to represent the future of Texas leadership.

Disclaimer: These are unofficial campaign materials produced by Magnet Moments Co. While a portion of the proceeds is donated to the campaign, this product is not officially affiliated with or commissioned by James Talarico or his official campaign committee.

products.title: Chicago Football “Good, Better, Best” Magnet Set (Set of 6)
products.description: Bring the spirit of Soldier Field right to your kitchen! Whether you are celebrating the 1985 glory days or surviving another season of "cardiac arrest" football, this set is the perfect way to sho...
products.descriptionHtml:
Bring the spirit of Soldier Field right to your kitchen! Whether you are celebrating the 1985 glory days or surviving another season of "cardiac arrest" football, this set is the perfect way to show your Chi-Town pride.

This 6-piece collection captures the true essence of being a Chicago fan—the history, the hustle, and the humor. Featuring iconic "Bear Down" slogans, vintage helmet artwork, and the classic motivational quote to keep your spirits high, these magnets are a touchdown for any man cave, office, or fridge.

The "Monsters of the Midway" Collection Includes:

• The Classic Roar: Iconic Bear head logo.

• The Reality Check: "Rebuilding Since 1985" (Funny because it’s true!).

• The Fan Life: "Good. Better. Best. Cardiac Arrest" – for the games that keep you on the edge of your seat.

• The History: Vintage-style "Chicago Football 1920" with helmet graphic.

• The Motivation: Two variations of the legendary "Good, Better, Best" quote.

Product Details:

• Quantity: Set of 6 Magnets

• Size: 2" x 2" (Square)

• Material: High-quality durable finish with a strong magnetic backing.

• Use: Perfect for holding up photos, game schedules, or tickets on any magnetic surface.

Why You’ll Love Them:

At Magnet Moments Co., we believe in "Moments that Stick!" These aren't just magnets; they are a badge of honor for the loyal fan who sticks by their team through the good, the bad, and the rebuilding years. Grab a set for yourself or gift one to the die-hard fan in your life!
